88.why: Passes split C/D; both are correct values of normal atmospheric pressure (101325 Pa = 76 cm of mercury). Defective as printed: two right options.
88.reasoning: Normal atmospheric pressure is about 101325 pascals, which is the same as the pressure of a column of mercury 76 cm high. So both (3) 101325 Pascals and (4) 76 cm of mercury are correct. 75.3 kilopascals is too low, and 76 mm of mercury is ten times too small.
88.notice: Two options are correct as printed: (3) 101325 Pascals and (4) 76 cm of mercury are the same pressure written in different units. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

99.why: Two units on the Richter scale = 100x ground amplitude; NCERT says about 1000x destructive energy, not an option. B is the best available.
99.notice: The Richter scale goes up by ten times the ground shaking for each step, so magnitude 6 shakes about 100 times as much as magnitude 4. The NCERT book says the destructive energy is about 1000 times greater, which is not among the options. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
